newsitem.title: NAMIBIA: Aircraft with five on board missing in Namib desert.
newsitem.headline: Aircraft with five on board missing in Namib desert.

text.p: Namibian search teams are trying to locate a missing Cessna aircraft with five people on board after it disappeared while on a sightseeing flight to the Namib desert on Thursday, a rescue official said on Friday.

Joggie Sell of the Search and Rescue Centre of the civil aviation directorate told Reuters a rescue team had been sent to look for the aircraft on Thursday but had been unable to track its whereabouts.
"The aircraft went out in the late afternoon to check the route the missing plane would have followed but couldn't find anything.
"Three more aircraft are searching a wider area today," Sell said.

He said the pilots of the Cessna 210 might have been forced to land because of turbulence and had not been able to contact the airport as communications in many areas had been interrupted by unusually heavy rains over the past two weeks.
Aircraft flying over the area had also been alerted to the missing plane, Sell said.
